product.olivetti-m54.summary: The desktop Linea 1 system that added cache and error-correcting memory.
product.olivetti-m54.history: The M54 retained the case and compatibility of the M30 and M34. Olivetti documented a new CPU board and up to three magnetic peripherals.
product.olivetti-m54.architecture: The cache decoupled the CPU from the bus. The manual gives 10 MHz for the UC070 in its introduction and 8 MHz for its Z8001B on the board page.
product.olivetti-m54.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m54.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
